basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old tech enthusiast living in Portland, Oregon. By day, I work as a software developer for a startup, and by night, I'm either gaming or exploring new PC builds. I enjoy diving into the world of cosmetics when I'm not tinkering with computers, which might explain my frequent visits to MakeupLounge. I'm in a committed relationship and love spending weekends hiking with my partner. Typically, I'm online during the evenings on weekdays and sporadically throughout the day on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over five years. My passion for technology extends to building and customizing PCs, an interest that started during college when I built my first rig. I've learned a lot through trial and error, as well as from online communities and forums.
